# Peanut Butter Fish Lessons

> > A homeschool curriculum resource site offering mini unit studies, geography materials, and educational activities for elementary through high school students.

Peanut Butter Fish Lessons provides hands-on learning materials including unit studies on topics like Mount Everest, US geography (Western States, territories), ocean creatures, and holiday-themed educational content. The site serves homeschooling families with printables, sorting mats, vocabulary cards, and comprehensive curriculum bundles spanning elementary to high school grades.

## High School Resources

- [Homeschool Collection High School Resources](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/homeschool-collection-high-school): High school homeschool bundle with ACT prep, transcripts, and courses

## Geography Unit Studies

- [US Geography Sorting Mats: Western States](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/us-geography-sorting-mats-western-states): Hands-on sorting mats for learning 15 western US states and facts
- [US Territories Unit Studies](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/us-territories-unit-studies): Unit studies for 5 US territories with videos, books, and projects
- [A Mount Everest Unit Study](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/mount-everest-unit-study): Mount Everest unit study with books, videos, and printables

## Science & Nature Unit Studies

- [Ocean Creatures Volume I | A Bundle of Animal Mini Unit Studies](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/ocean-creatures-unit-studies-1): Six ocean creature mini unit studies bundle for elementary grades
- [Fresh Water Vocabulary Concept of the Day Cards](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/fresh-water-vocabulary-concept-of-the-day-cards): 30-day fresh water biome vocabulary cards for elementary science

## Holiday & Seasonal Unit Studies

- [St. Nicholas Day | A Holiday Mini Unit Study](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/st-nicholas-day-unit-study): St. Nicholas Day mini unit with videos, books, and activities
- [Flag Day | A Holiday Mini Unit Study](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/flag-day-unit-study): Flag Day mini unit study with videos, books, and activities

## Thematic Mini Unit Studies

- [Ships | A Summer Mini Unit Study](https://peanutbutterfishlessons.com/product/ships-a-summer-mini-unit-study): Ships summer mini unit with videos, books, and hands-on activities
